capabilities: generate AI summaries for canvas link cards
scrape page metadata and cover images
enrich link cards via context menu or command
auto-enrich link cards pasted into a canvas
batch-enrich all link cards in a canvas
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Canvas link cards show only a bare URL without a summary or preview image, and filling them in manually is tedious.

relations.evidence: Twitter/X support — extracts tweet content, images, and author info via fxtwitter API

summary: Canvas plugin that enriches link cards with AI-generated summaries, metadata, and cover images scraped from the linked page.
